title: Solomon’s Palace and Temple Furnishings

questions.question: How long did it take Solomon to build his own house?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:1 (ESV): "Solomon was building his own house thirteen years, and he finished his entire house."

questions.question: What was the name of the large hall Solomon built?
options: House of the Forest of Lebanon
questions.correctAnswer: House of the Forest of Lebanon
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:2 (ESV): "He built the House of the Forest of Lebanon. Its length was 100 cubits..."

questions.question: Who was the skilled bronze worker Solomon brought from Tyre?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:13 (ESV): "And King Solomon sent and brought Hiram from Tyre."

questions.question: What were the names of the two pillars set up at the temple vestibule?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:21 (ESV): "He set up the pillar on the south and called its name Jachin, and he set up the pillar on the north and called its name Boaz."

questions.question: What large bronze basin did Hiram make?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:23 (ESV): "Then he made the sea of cast metal. It was round, ten cubits from brim to brim..."

questions.question: How many stands of bronze did he make?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:27 (ESV): "He also made the ten stands of bronze. Each stand was four cubits long..."

questions.question: What animals were on the borders of the stands?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:29 (ESV): "...on the panels that were set in the frames were lions, oxen, and cherubim."

questions.question: Where were the ten stands placed?
options: Five on the south side and five on the north side of the house
questions.correctAnswer: Five on the south side and five on the north side of the house
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:39 (ESV): "And he put five stands on the south side of the house and five on the north side of the house."

questions.question: Who was Hiram filled with wisdom and skill to work in?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:14 (ESV): "...He was full of wisdom, understanding, and skill for making any work in bronze."

questions.question: How much water could the Sea hold?
What was the height of the two pillars including the capitals?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:15-16 (ESV): "He cast two pillars of bronze. Eighteen cubits was the height of one... He also made two capitals... The height of the one capital was five cubits..."

questions.question: How many rows of cedar pillars were in the House of the Forest of Lebanon?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:2 (ESV): "...it was built on four rows of cedar pillars, with cedar beams on the pillars."

questions.question: What stood on top of the Sea of cast metal?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:25 (ESV): "It stood on twelve oxen, three facing north, three facing west..."

questions.question: What materials were the pots, shovels, and basins made of?
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:45 (ESV): "...all these vessels that Hiram made for King Solomon for the house of the LORD were of burnished bronze."

questions.question: Where did the king cast the bronze vessels?
options: In the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan
questions.correctAnswer: In the plain of the Jordan between Succoth and Zarethan
questions.explanation: 1 Kings 7:46 (ESV): "In the plain of the Jordan the king cast them, in the clay ground between Succoth and Zarethan."

key_verse_text: Thus all the work that King Solomon did on the house of the LORD was finished. And Solomon brought in the things that David his father had dedicated, the silver, the gold, and the vessels, and stored them in the treasuries of the house of the LORD. (ESV)
